essay.instructions: `chapters` is the outline of a novel, a summary of each of its chapters in order; `threads` lists the questions its story raises and where each is settled; `people` lists its characters and what changes for each. How much would a critic find to say about this novel?
criteria: A critic would find nothing to say about this novel
A critic would give this novel a paragraph in a survey of its kind
A critic would find an essay in this novel
A critic would find more in this novel than an essay could hold

course.instructions: `chapters` is the outline of a novel, a summary of each of its chapters in order; `threads` lists the questions its story raises and where each is settled; `people` lists its characters and what changes for each. What would become of it in a university course on the novel?
criteria: This novel would not be assigned
This novel would be read as an example of its genre
This novel would be read for how it is made
This novel would be read as a turn in what the novel can do
